description: This file defines an enumeration DurationFormattingSupport with a static method conciseDuration that formats a duration in milliseconds into a concise string representation. It provides logic to convert milliseconds into seconds, minutes, hours, or days with rounded integer values.

methods.name: conciseDuration
methods.description: Converts a duration in milliseconds to a concise string format, choosing the most appropriate time unit (ms, s, m, h, d) with rounded values.
